hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; OUT=$(.venv/bin/python tools/queue_check.py 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{systemMessage:"BUILD QUEUE BELOW FLOOR - research stocks it before other work", hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; else jq -n --arg o "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$o}}'; fi
